name: 59912 · Columbia Fls, MT
findings: ZIP 59912 (Columbia Fls) has 35 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 59912 (Columbia Fls) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
